title: perf(canary): improve auto-detection and rollout guards for latency/throughput regressions
author: Asha Malik
commits: b1f9d2a - add statistical detection module and canary gating hooks
2c4e7e1 - integrate detection with rollout controller and add circuit-breaking policy
7a3b0ff - expose new metrics and labels for per-route baselines
c9d4f21 - unit/integration tests for detector and rollback behavior
f5a8b33 - docs: runtime and console docs for canary thresholds
description:
Motivation: We've seen instances where subtle throughput and P99 latency regressions slip past manual canary checks and later cause customer incidents. This PR improves the performance-canary pipeline by adding an automated detection module (windowed-statistics z-score + EWMA baseline) and stronger rollout guards that can automatically halt and rollback model rollouts when regressions are detected.

What this changes: - New perf-canary/detector.py implementing a windowed baseline per-route/model and an adaptive z-score detector with configurable sensitivity. - Controller integration (runtime/rollout/controller.py) to evaluate detector signals during canary cohorts and atomically mark cohorts as failed. - Rollout guards (runtime/rollout/guards.py) implementing:   * immediate halt on sustained P99 increase above threshold,   * throughput degradation detection,   * configurable grace windows to avoid false positives during transient spikes. - Metrics: new perf canary metrics (observability/metrics/perf_canary.prom) plus labels to attribute signals to model version/route/customer. - Tests and docs: end-to-end unit/integration tests demonstrate detection and rollback, and docs/perf-canary.md explains new config knobs and recommended thresholds.

Backwards compatibility / migration: The detector is opt-in via rollout policy (default disabled). Existing rollouts keep current behavior until project teams opt-in. Configuration supports per-route overrides and a global sane default.

Validation: Local perf lab runs and a staged canary on internal services: - Simulated P99 regression of +18% was detected within 3 canary windows and the rollout was automatically halted. - Simulated throughput drop of ~22% triggered the throughput guard and executed a rollback policy. Both cases were validated by smoke tests and metric assertions (see tests/perf_canary/test_detector.py).

Checklist: - [x] Detector implementation - [x] Controller integration - [x] Guard policies and rollback hooks - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Docs for runtime and console - [x] Add telemetry labels for attribution

Related: ENG-2045 (perf canary roadmap), ENG-2102 (rollout safety improvements).
